fields.name: Planes
fields.evidence: Toolkit GameEngine.dll+0x1335A0 (ls::CullTriggerPlanesComponent::CullTriggerPlanesComponent) zeroes 12 qwords +0..+0x58; operator= (GameEngine.dll+0x1350D0) copies them. GameEngine.dll+0x8FA7A0 (called from ls::trigger::CullingPlanesUpdateSystem::ProcessUpdates) runs ls::trigger::CalculateCullingPlanes(AreaPhysics, Transform) and copies 24 floats into +0..+0x5C: six planes (normal xyz + distance). Live: normals are unit axis vectors (0, +-1, tiny 3.6e-7) and the 4th float of each 16 bytes is a large signed distance (80.99, 326.5, ...).

fields.name: IsValid
fields.evidence: Constructor sets byte +0x60 to 0; GameEngine.dll+0x8FA7A0 sets it to 1 only when CalculateCullingPlanes succeeded (otherwise it logs 'CullTrigger `%s` physics should always be BOX, otherwise the culling won't work.'). Live: byte 0x60 always 1.

fields.name: _Pad61
fields.evidence: Tail padding: the Toolkit object ends at 0x61 but is 16-byte aligned (vec4 SIMD planes), so the registry size is 0x70 (bg3.exe+0x6E99E0 sets the storage size 0x70). The constructor never writes these bytes; live samples show garbage there (random values, even heap-looking ones).

summary: Client culling: the six world-space planes of a cull trigger's box (ls::trigger::CullingPlanesUpdateSystem recomputes them when the trigger moves/rotates/scales); read by ls::ClusterSystem (SetupNewCullTriggerCluster) and ls::ClusterVisibilitySystem to cull clusters. Present on the cull-trigger entities of idle levels.
open_questions: 'IsValid' is an inferred name for the 'planes computed' flag.
